dataset.forex_clock: FXCM archive winter New York UTC-05; exclude Saturday and Friday after 22 / Sunday before 22 UTC
dataset.prior_development_overlap: These dates precede existing technical fixtures, but source archives were already retrieved; not a prospective blind financial trial.

selection: Compare fixed candidate 0, pooled, market-group, and symbol-specific. Choose using validation lower mean R only after >=5 development and >=3 validation trades for EVERY instrument in the group. Score is equal-weight mean of instrument means, tie -> lower candidate index. If none qualify, no selection. Freeze selection before inspecting holdout. No candidate edits after holdout.
cost_stress: Double nonnegative spread/slippage/fee/carry charges after selection; do not reselect.
missing_data: Undeclared intramarket gaps split the series into independent contiguous blocks. Reset ATR/channel warmup. Censor positions at the missing boundary. Do not relabel missing data as scheduled closures.
stability: Descriptive UTC six-hour entry blocks and lagged channel-width/ATR <4,4-8,>=8; no probability or liquidity-regime claim. Minimum 20 holdout trades per instrument and >=5 per reported subgroup before even considering a new independent validation; not a sufficient profitability gate.
